The lowest common ancestor of Pethidine and Oxymorphone is the organonitrogen compound, indicating a shared biological pathway. While the evidence supports a relationship between Pethidine and Oprk1 through the opioid receptor agonist mechanism, the strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on classification and binding data from a single pathway.
